name: Organic
thesis: The app is grown, not assembled: irregular rhythm, natural color, and materials that feel handled.
bestFor: Food, cooking, gardening, farming, nature, sustainability, and slow living.

variants.name: Market Table
variants.summary: A market stall: abundant produce, hand-written price tags, and a warm crowd of cards.
variants.signature: A hand-written price tag pinned to the image.
variants.treatment: Warm cream, produce photography, tilted tags, and a loose but readable grid.

variants.name: Garden Plot
variants.summary: A garden bed: rows, seasons, and a calm record of what is growing.
variants.signature: A seasonal band across the top of the plot.
variants.treatment: Deep green surfaces, row-based layout, botanical labels, and a seasonal color band.

variants.name: Slow Kitchen
variants.summary: A kitchen notebook: a recipe in steps, generous ingredients, and no rush.
variants.signature: A timeline that marks the resting and cooking stages.
variants.treatment: Paper white, serif display, ingredient lists in the margin, and a long vertical timeline.

signatureMoves: A hand-written price tag pinned to the image.
A seasonal band across the top of the plot.
A timeline that marks the resting and cooking stages.
An ingredient list that sits in the margin.

platform.ios: Use a large title and a warm surface. Keep the system back gesture. Use SF Symbols with a rounded weight. Support Dynamic Type; keep body text at least 17pt. Motion should be gentle and respect reduce motion.
platform.android: Edge-to-edge with a compact top app bar. Use Material Symbols with a rounded style. Support 200% font scale and predictive back. Keep touch targets at 48dp. Avoid hard shadows.

principles: Warmth comes from color and material, not from shadows.
The recipe or plant is always the hero.
avoid: A generic wellness gradient over a stock photo.
Every card rotated in a different direction.
Serif used for long dense data.
Fake farms, fake certifications, or invented sourcing claims.

screens.home: One seasonal feature with a real photograph and a short line, then a loose grid of recipes or plants. Use whitespace and scale, not a wall of equal cards.
screens.detail: A recipe or plant detail: image, name, season, time, ingredients or care, then steps. Ingredients sit near the top; the method is readable in one column.
screens.compose: A planting or recipe note: what, when, where, and one photo. Keep it short and preserve drafts.
screens.profile: A garden record: what is growing, what was harvested, and what is saved. No invented social feed.

components.button: Softly rounded 12-18pt, solid earthy fill, generous padding. Secondary actions are text with a rule.
components.list: Image-forward rows with an irregular but consistent rhythm. Tags can tilt; text never does.
components.input: Warm paper field with a visible label and hand-friendly height. Validation in plain language.
components.navigation: Large title, tab bar for three peers, sheets for detail. No floating buttons.
